Review: Wang & Blaabjerg — Reliability of Capacitors for DC-Link Applications: An Overview
Main_Taxonomy: Capacitor type x (reliability-oriented design | condition monitoring)

Review: Soliman, Wang & Blaabjerg — A Review of the Condition Monitoring of Capacitors in Power Electronic Converters
Main_Limitation: Stops at parameter estimation; no SOH/RUL/prognostics layer; pre-deep-learning

Review: Dang & Kwak — Review of Health Monitoring Techniques for Capacitors Used in Power Electronics Converters
Main_Taxonomy: Estimated parameter (ESR | C) x measurement principle

Review: Nathan et al. — Review of condition monitoring methods for capacitors used in power converters
Main_Taxonomy: CM method family + ANN-based predictive maintenance
Main_Limitation: ML treated as a method list; no PHM-level discrimination; no uncertainty; no deployment analysis

Review: Muhammed Ramees & Ahmad — Advances in Capacitor Health Monitoring Techniques for Power Converters: A Review
Main_Taxonomy: Converter topology x output-filter type (C | LC | both) x offline/online
Main_Limitation: Organised by topology not by health-state capability; SOH absent; RUL only incidental; 'hybrid model' means switched-circuit model not PIML

Review: Torki, Joubert & Sari — Electrolytic capacitor: Properties and operation
Main_Taxonomy: Component physics: construction / properties / ageing laws / predictive maintenance
Main_Limitation: Component-centric not converter-centric; no online estimation in a running converter; no algorithmic taxonomy

Review: Fassi et al. — Toward Physics-Informed ML-Based Predictive Maintenance for Power Converters: A Review
Capacitor_Type: Capacitors as ONE of several components
Main_Limitation: Not capacitor-specific — capacitors share space with semiconductors/solder/PCB; no capacitor-level indicator-to-physics mapping; no per-method deployability scoring

Review: Yu et al. — Review of Health Monitoring Techniques for Capacitors in Modular Multilevel Converters
Main_Taxonomy: MMC monitoring method category x implementation
